messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #3421 adds a usage heatmap example to /docs/usage/heatmaps but the SDK link in the snippet goes to the old v1 path and 404s. @maria can you take a look? :eyes:
maria: On it. I saw the preview failed linting too, maybe related to the snippet copy/paste. Sending a quick patch if it's just a link.
docs-bot: Preview build 3421 is ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/3421 (status: failed lint) :warning:
sam: If it's helpful, here's a minimal Python example that matches the new SDK packaging — we should replace the broken inline link with the new docs route and the snippet below. Feel free to paste:```
python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
heatmap = client.metrics.get_usage_heatmap(start='2026-02-01', end='2026-02-28', granularity='day')
for row in heatmap:
    print(row)
```
ryan: +1 on swapping the link. Also we should add a short note that the heatmap accepts timezone or uses UTC by default — I hit a user question yesterday. Maybe add a one-line param example in the snippet.
maria: Working on a small PR on top of 3421: replacing the link to /sdk/python/metrics/heatmap, adding timezone param example, and fixing the code fence indentation that triggered the linter.
alex: Perfect. Can you also add a quickline under the figure telling users where the Grafana panel name lives (panel: metering_usage_heatmap) so integrators can map metric names?
maria: Yep. I'll add "panel: metering_usage_heatmap" and a link to the dashboard: /dashboards/metering/overview.
sam: Suggest adding a single test prompt in docs/tests/snippets_test.py that imports the snippet and asserts the object shape so we catch regressions. Simple: assert isinstance(heatmap, list) and len(heatmap) >= 0
docs-bot: CI: snippets_test passed on branch docs/fix-heatmap-snippet (build 3421.3) :white_check_mark:
ryan: Who's reviewing? I can do a quick pass for accuracy and phrasing.
maria: @ryan awesome, thanks. Assigning you as reviewer in the PR. ETA EOD today.
alex: Nice catch — once merged we should add a redirect from the old broken URL to the new SDK path to avoid external 404s (analytics tracked one external 404 yesterday). Can ops/infra add a short redirect? @ops-team?
ryan: Quick editorial nit: change "usage heatmap" header to sentence case "Usage heatmap" to match style guide.
maria: Done both (link, timezone param, panel note, header case). Pushed.
docs-bot: PR #3421 merged by maria at 2026-03-12T16:05:10Z. Redirect ticket #467 created for ops.
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes snippet and notify support to close the related customer 404 ticket. :tada:
